ENB Runtime Core.

ENB Runtime Core is a C++23 embedded runtime library that identifies an already-loaded ENBSeries host, validates its SDK surface, queues callbacks outside callback context, coordinates save quiescence and reapplication, and gates a fail-closed Skyrim engine bridge.
